name: Camp Kawanhee
description_short: An overnight camp for boys on a lake in Weld, Maine. Boys live in lodges of 8 to 10 campers with two counselors, and stays run from 2 weeks up to a 7-week full season. Boys aged 16 and 17 can join a Leadership Training program.
special_needs_notes: The kitchen works with families to provide gluten-free and allergy-friendly meals, and vegetarian options are always available. A Maine-licensed RN works full-time on site and lives in the infirmary. All medications, including over-the-counter ones, are kept in the infirmary and given at mealtimes unless a prescription requires a different time. Counselors handle bedwetting privately.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on a lake with a swimming dock and lifeguards on duty. Campers can join an optional 7 AM "Polar Bear" morning swim. Waterfront staff get extra training before the season.

warnings: Trailblazer sessions are listed as 13 days, but the dates (June 20–July 3 and July 18–31) cover 14 calendar days. The '13' may count nights.
Air travelers are shuttled to the airport on Sunday, August 8, 2027, one day after sessions ending August 7.

Discounts: $500 off for enrolling and paying the deposit by November 1, 2026 (with timely tuition payments), $500 off per son for families sending two or more sons, and $800 off for referring a new camper who enrolls. A $200 spending-money deposit is recommended ($300 for ages 15–17), separate from tuition.
Trailblazer enrollment is described as strictly limited.
The linked parent handbook is the 2025 edition, so details that only appear there may be out of date.
